new_finding: The latest safe work point is not generally one scalar timestamp; it is a frontier that depends on the next unit's duration plus close reserve and safety margin.
formalization: remaining_slack = hard_cap - elapsed - close_reserve - safety_margin; admit next unit only when its credible duration fits the slack.
design_result: Final program should expose both a conservative scalar PRODUCTIVE_CAP for simple P1/P2 operation and a task-size-aware COMPLETION_ENVELOPE for P3/P4. Complexity is promoted only if variable task sizes make the scalar cutoff materially wasteful.
